statement: Each fighter's beam has its own look from data (width, ripple, edge, pattern), coloured by the fighter's lane colour and never white at the core.
The beam struggle is shown by the beams themselves (width, swells, the meeting point) with no bar or marker, as the taste page asks.
The project is set to the Compatibility renderer on every platform, and the shaders avoid flat varyings and depth-texture reads; one shader reads the screen and has a lighter fallback.

At start-up the game compiles the scene's shaders a few a frame behind a plain line and bar, and draws a list of 21 effect shaders once (plus the two tile shaders when the globe ground is on) so their first use in a fight does not compile.
Orb's 'feet sinking into the ground at the start' was traced to a cause and its three render fixes are on main (each park's patch reverse-applies to the baseline).
Six render checks run in CI on every push: determinism of the sim under rendering, the seam sweep, the pane sweep, props, and two water checks.
The player's Reduce flashing and Reduced motion choices are handed to the effects' flash register every frame.
The transformation's effects, the aura while charging or attacking, and the world's reaction from the third tier are on by default, and bystanders are drawn running from a blow.
